description: Assess how ready a product category is for an EU Digital Product Passport, against the delegated act that applies to it. Returns the required data fields, which are present, and which are missing. For batteries (category "batteries", or "lmt" / "ev" / "industrial" / "stationary") the assessment is against the Commission's 71 numbered data points: score, missing, not-required-yet, awaiting first reading and go_live_ready per passport; pass unit_id for one battery passport. IMPORTANT: this is a readiness signal, not a legal compliance determination — never report its output as confirmation that a product is compliant.

category.description: Product group, e.g. "batteries", "textiles", "iron_steel", "furniture", "tyres", "aluminium"; or a battery category "lmt", "ev", "industrial", "stationary".

unit_id.description: Optional: one chain unit (cun_…) holding a battery passport, for its own readiness.

name: dpp_readiness
title: Passport readiness
